fields.Name: W6 -> S6.1
fields.Description: Gate G2.41 (phase 2, dataset W6, criterion S6.1): with out_of_time on StartDate at 2024-01-01, the holdout is the 6,950 rows from 2024 on, AUC is within 0.02 of 0.6447, and mean predicted minus observed is >= +0.15 (T6(a)). W6-drift s42, a date-carved holdout on StartDate; the bias is read from the stored calibration reliability bins. It fails when the out_of_time carve uses the decision date instead of the declared StartDate (holdout != 6,950 rows).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 6,950 holdout rows; holdout AUC within 0.02 of 0.6447; mean predicted minus observed at least +0.15.
